Input prediction
options.

Choose from Tater, Best, Saiko, Delta, F, Cloud, Meow, Ancient, Next, Snow and Salatik.

Tater — adjust the prediction amount and whether it applies to other players in Nova settings.

Other features: a server browser, friends list, Twitch messages in chat, hook and interpolation settings, and AntiPing smoothing.

Attempts, history
and finishes.

Check how many times you've tried a map, review your server history, or save a card when you finish.

Per-server visits, saves, lasts, deaths and online time.
